exam.title: AWS Certified Data Engineer - Associate
exam.study_prerequisites: No formal prerequisite; AWS targets candidates with two to three years of data-engineering experience and one to two years of hands-on AWS experience. Practice SQL, batch/stream/CDC ingestion, distributed processing, store and schema design, orchestration, IaC, data quality, monitoring, IAM, Lake Formation, KMS, privacy, lineage, replay and recovery.

review.notes: The December 12, 2025 version 1.1 DEA-C01 guide was reconciled with four detailed domains, the in-scope list, revision record and live certification page. The guide closes LLM, Iceberg, vector-index/vectorization, Bedrock knowledge-base, SageMaker Catalog/Unified Studio and service-scope additions and labels older training incomplete. Three scenarios, eight labs and 40 original checks cover ingestion/replay, transformation/orchestration, stores/models/catalog/lifecycle/schema, SQL/operations/quality and end-to-end security/governance. All 28 URLs are cataloged: 25 reachable and two O'Reilly books plus Udemy automation-blocked; none missing or broken. Volatile metadata is labeled and no recalled questions are used.

findings.title: Managed table storage needs distinction from format
findings.evidence: S3 Tables automates table/bucket maintenance with configurable defaults.
findings.recommendation: Add format/storage/engine comparison and retention obligations.
findings.resolution: Add format/storage/engine comparison and retention obligations.

findings.title: Named audit feature closed to new customers
findings.evidence: May 31 closure; organization/account EDS expansion differs; trails remain supported.
findings.recommendation: Keep exam concept and add accurate availability/alternative lab path.
findings.resolution: Keep exam concept and add accurate availability/alternative lab path.

findings.title: Connector and transformation lifecycle changes
findings.evidence: ODBC 1.x extended to December 31; TLS minimum October 31; Python UDF support ended June 30 with phased enforcement; patch-specific LF mutation changes.
findings.recommendation: Add dated migration/diagnostic table with scope limits.
findings.resolution: Add dated migration/diagnostic table with scope limits.
